description: Simulation and empirical data agree within tolerance. Record can be promoted to solved.
notes: Confidence score should be updated upward; record moves to backmatter

primary_trigger: consistent offset in Lambda; no energy mismatch
description: Systematic positive or negative shift in Lambda across multiple records. Suggests state-prior bias.
notes: Check state_prior_table for bias in Lambda_bar_nm

primary_trigger: consistent offset in E; Lambda acceptable
description: Systematic energy offset. Lambda recovery is correct but energy magnitude is off.
notes: May indicate UFF/CFF scale factor error; check casting calibration

description: Simulation recovers a longer-range interaction than the data supports. Field is reaching too far.
notes: Check cutoff radius; consider adding environment screening term

description: Simulation under-recovers the length scale. Interaction is not being fully captured.
notes: May need finer resolution or sub-object decomposition

primary_trigger: Lambda and E both low for dense/crystal systems
description: Many-body dispersion contributions missing. Common in crystal, solution, and surface states.
notes: Enable many-body vdW correction; generate packing and density variation runs

description: Sigma-hole, pi-hole, or lone-pair halo not captured. Gap is geometry-sensitive.
notes: Generate orientation variation and halogen/chalcogen/pnictogen/tetrel test cases

primary_trigger: gap is state-dependent rather than family-dependent
description: Wrong Lambda_bar or sigma for the declared state. Prior does not match the substance context.
notes: Update state_prior_table; rerun with corrected Lambda_bar

description: Screening model not matching environment dielectric. Common in solution and biological_pocket.
notes: Check dielectric_epsilon input; test with explicit solvent runs

description: Force-force casting does not match field-field prediction. Casting layer inconsistency.
notes: Check casting_primary and casting_secondary assignment; verify channel mapping

primary_trigger: gap vanishes when geometry is fixed
description: Interaction is orientation-sensitive and the sim is sampling the wrong geometry ensemble.
notes: Fix geometry_mode; generate slipped_parallel vs face-on vs T-shaped comparison runs

primary_trigger: gap varies with branching or connectivity
description: Interaction recovery depends on molecular topology in a way the model does not currently capture.
notes: Vary conjugation length, branching factor, and ring count in next generation

primary_trigger: Lambda recovered but poorly converged; high sigma
description: Resolution too coarse. Lambda is in the right range but uncertainty is unacceptably high.
notes: Reduce dt or increase run length; check convergence criterion

epsilon_Lambda_condition: Lambda_data is null or coverage_count < min_coverage
description: No empirical data available for comparison. Record cannot be validated.
notes: Flag for empiricalDB expansion; cannot resolve gap without data
